target_ast_node.description: Optional AST node context (provenance only), e.g. Class: DatabaseConnector

skill_domain.description: Skill domain selecting a pinned pruned slice, e.g. react-hooks

quantization.description: Quantization tag (default 1.58-bit; only 1.58-bit is implemented in PoC)

max_ram_mb.description: Hard RAM cap for the agent sandbox (default 512)

quality_floor.description: Optional observed quality score; when guardrail is enabled, breach escalates to dense GPU via HAL

task_description.description: Optional prompt for dense GPU escalation when quality_floor breaches
